description_en: Twośikharatemples from approximately 13th-15th century.The monuments are found in the southern part of the Bhurtī Temple Complex. The site itself is located in the northern end of the settlement of Bhurtī, 3 km north of Narayana, the district headquarters. It currently comprises 22 standingśikharatemples (ordevala) and one stone fountain. Architectural activity at the site can be situated between the 13thand 15thcentury, a time period corresponding to the latter part of the Khaśa Malla empire and the early phase of the Rāskoṭi dynasty (Andolfatto 2019,Pokharel 2011: 128-129,Sharma 1972: 23-31,Sharma 2012: 120-123).In 2008, the “Bhurti Temple Complex of Dailekh” was enlisted on UNESCO’s World Heritage Tentative List by the Government of Nepal (criteriaiiandiv).The two monuments are built in front of each other, in a plan usually referred to asduidevala(double temple). Their orientations are south and north. In the absence of epigraphic data the temples can tentatively be dated from the 13th-15th century. The religious affiliation of the temples is Śaiva, as indicated by the presence, in each sanctum, of a circular stone slab with a central mortise that must have hosted aśivaliṅga.The southernśikharawas missing itsāmalakaring and a new one was recently installed. As for the other recently madeāmalakarings seen at the site, this one's proportions are uncorrect (too small in circumference and too thick).
description_ne: भुर्ती मन्दिर पसिरमा २२ शिखर मन्दिरहरू र एउटा ढुङ्गे धारा छन् । सन् २००८ मा यो मन्दिर परिसरलाई नेपाल सरकारले UNESCO’s World Heritage को ‘tentative list’ मा सूचीकृत गरेको थियो । यहाँ प्रस्तुत दुईवटा शिखर मन्दिरहरू भुर्ती मन्दिर परिसरको दक्षिण भागमा अवस्थित छ। यी मन्दिरहरू ईशाको तेह्रौंदेखि पन्ध्रौं शताब्दीभित्रमा निर्माण गरिएका हुनुपर्दछ तर यो कुरा पुष्टि गर्ने कुनै ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेज भने उपलब्ध छैन । यी दुई मन्दिरहरूमा एउटा दक्षिण र अर्को उत्तरतर्फ फर्केका छन् र यस्तो प्रकारको संरचनालाइ दुई देवल भनिन्छ । यी देवलहरूको गर्भगृहको संरचना हेर्दा शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरेको हुनुपर्ने देखिन्छ र त्यसैले यी मन्दिरहरू शैव सम्प्रदायसंग सम्बन्धित थिए होलान् कि भन्ने अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ । यी दुई देवलमध्ये दक्षिण तर्फको देवलमा भएको आमलक हराएको थियो त्यसैले एउटा नयाँ आमलक भर्खरै मात्र राखिएको छ ।
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired), Structural damages
